profile.summary: Kee Ming Group Berhad provides mechanical and electrical engineering solutions in Malaysia. It operates in two segments, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Services, and Maintenance and Repair Services. The company offers electrical engineering services, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, and extra low voltage electrical installation, as well as earthing and lighting protection systems, electrical substations, street lighting installation, solar PV installation, EV charging solutions, and uninterruptible power supply, isolated power supply, and generator sets. It also provides mechanical engineering services, such as air conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems comprising chiller systems, variable refrigerant flow systems, air duct systems, smoke spill systems, and cleanroom systems; and fire protection systems, which include automatic fire sprinkler systems, hose reel systems, fire alarm systems, and fire suppression systems. In addition, the company offers maintenance and repair services for mechanical and electrical engineering systems, such as amp checking, blower fan and motor, chemical wash, cleaning condensing unit, compressor, replace filter dryer, and top up refrigerant gas. It serves residential, industrial, commercial, clean energy, and infrastructures and interconnection facilities industries. The company was formerly known as KM Group Sdn. Bhd. and changed its name to Kee Ming Group Berhad in June 2025. Kee Ming Group Berhad was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Ipoh, Malaysia.
profile.zh: Kee Ming Group Berhad 是一家马来西亚的机械与电气工程解决方案提供商，成立于2013年，总部位于怡保。公司运营机械与电气工程服务以及维护与维修服务两大业务板块，服务于住宅、工业、商业、清洁能源及基础设施等行业。
lines: 电气工程服务：提供高压、中压、低压及特低压电气安装，以及接地与防雷系统、变电站、路灯安装、太阳能光伏安装、电动汽车充电解决方案、不间断电源、隔离电源和发电机组。
机械工程服务：提供空调与机械通风系统，包括冷水机组系统、变制冷剂流量系统、风管系统、排烟系统及洁净室系统。
消防系统：提供自动喷水灭火系统、软管卷盘系统、火灾报警系统及灭火系统。
维护与维修服务：为机械与电气工程系统提供维护和维修服务，如电流检查、风机与电机维护、化学清洗、冷凝器清洗、压缩机维护、更换干燥过滤器及补充制冷剂。
lines_en: Electrical Engineering Services: Provide high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, and extra low voltage electrical installations, earthing and lightning protection systems, electrical substations, street lighting installation, solar PV installation, EV charging solutions, uninterruptible power supply, isolated power supply, and generator sets.

Mechanical Engineering Services: Provide air conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems, including chiller systems, variable refrigerant flow systems, air duct systems, smoke spill systems, and cleanroom systems.
Fire Protection Systems: Provide automatic fire sprinkler systems, hose reel systems, fire alarm systems, and fire suppression systems.

Maintenance and Repair Services: Provide maintenance and repair services for mechanical and electrical engineering systems, such as amp checking, blower fan and motor, chemical wash, cleaning condensing unit, compressor, replace filter dryer, and top up refrigerant gas.
